counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event on N (t=360,duration 158); same steps/params. Failure disappears, proving the blind detector causes the stuck NS green.

explanation: NS green starts ~step 292 and is still green at steps 360,377,480,487 — ~195s continuous, far beyond max_green_seconds=85. The detector_fail on N (active from t=360) blinds the controller to N's queue; actuated gap-out/max-green/recall logic then never terminates NS green despite E waiting 74s at 360 rising to 201s at 487 with queue growing 34 to 74. Without the failure the same demand cycles normally (counterfactual E wait only 11s at 487), so the cause is max-green/recall not enforced while a held-direction detector is failed.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: East-west approaches remain on red with long blue queues that persist across steps 484 to 487. North-south signals stay green the entire time, so the queued cross traffic is never served despite the buildup.
